title: Performance retest and validation
description: Re-run pipeline, compare to baseline, validate Power BI query performance, document optimized results in performance_optimized.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline retest run 3 times, matching the methodology used for the task-012_1 baseline.
Activity-level durations recorded and compared against the baseline, bronze/silver/gold broken out.
Power BI query response times recorded for representative report pages.
A before/after comparison table is committed to .claude/support/documents/performance_optimized.md, stating the measured deltas whatever they are — including null or negative results.
Any optimization that measurably made things worse is called out explicitly rather than omitted.
notes: Erik runs in Fabric; Claude can prepare the comparison template.
If <30% improvement, document findings and adjust strategy before closing.

AC REWRITE 2026-07-29 (/work coherence audit): the previous criteria carried three SLA thresholds (total runtime <20 min, Power BI queries <3s, overall improvement >30%) with no source in the spec, contradicting spec § Performance Optimization: "Not benchmarked — manual pipeline runs at portfolio scale. No production load or SLA requirements." Phase 3's own acceptance criterion asks only for "basic performance review done". Criteria are now measure-and-record: the comparison table is the deliverable and the numbers are whatever they are. A portfolio-scale pipeline that is already fast may legitimately show no meaningful improvement — that is a valid result, not a failed task.

RISK RECORDED: the 012_4 CREATE INDEX block is likely to be rejected — Fabric Data Warehouse clusters via CLUSTER BY on CREATE TABLE/CTAS and accepts only PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED NOT ENFORCED; CREATE CLUSTERED/NONCLUSTERED INDEX is not in its T-SQL surface (verified against Fabric docs, not by execution). The UPDATE STATISTICS block is supported and should be run regardless. A rejected index block is a valid finding, not a task failure.
